aboutGame.title: What is Saw Genesis?
paragraphs: Saw Genesis is a survival horror experience rooted in the Saw franchise's origin era. Players step into trap-filled rooms and race a timer that never stops, turning observation, communication, and risk math into the skills that decide whether they escape.

Saw Genesis Wiki covers the full picture: how the 3v1 mode works, every trap archetype and its counterplay, the characters and apprentices behind Jigsaw's legacy, and where to follow release news. Whether you are reading your first room or refining escape routes, these guides are built to keep you alive.

explore.description: Dive into Saw Genesis Wiki with beginner walkthroughs, character breakdowns, trap mechanics, release news, and trailer analysis — everything you need in one place.

modules.name: Saw Genesis Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module introduces new players to the core loop: the 3v1 format, hunter and survivor roles, objectives, and the survival habits that keep a first match alive.

highlights.detail: Read the room before you move — release mechanisms are usually within arm's reach.
Assign roles early: an objective lead, a scout, and a support who covers revives.
Disarm traps only while the hunter is accounted for, and call every cleared route.
Push two objectives at once so the hunter can only pressure one of them.
Convert to a single escape route in the end game instead of splitting up late.

modules.name: Saw Genesis Wiki Gameplay Mechanics
modules.description: This module explains the systems that decide a match: trap categories, timed puzzles, procedural rooms, injuries, revives, and the objective clock.

highlights.label: Traps
highlights.detail: Timed puzzles with a moral edge — read the mechanism, find the leverage, decide fast.

highlights.label: Puzzles
highlights.detail: Codes, patterns, and symbols reward deduction over raw reflexes.

highlights.label: Injuries
highlights.detail: Downed survivors can be revived, and a revive is the biggest momentum swing.

highlights.label: Maps
highlights.detail: Procedural trial rooms change layout, so scout before you commit.

highlights.label: Timer
highlights.detail: One countdown with staged objectives forces decisions over perfect play.

highlights.label: Teamwork
highlights.detail: Communication is a mechanic; silent teams lose to one coordinated hunter.

modules.name: Saw Genesis Wiki Tips and Strategies
modules.description: Practical strategies for both sides: rotation, splitting objectives, callouts, and the greedy mistakes that turn one down into two.

highlights.label: Rotate
highlights.detail: Make the hunter walk — every second spent chasing is time your team gains.

highlights.label: Split Up
highlights.detail: Push two objectives in two locations so the hunter can only pressure one.

highlights.label: Stay Calm
highlights.detail: Panic sprinting reveals your position; walk when the hunter is close.

highlights.label: Callouts
highlights.detail: Short, directional, actionable callouts keep three players coordinated.

highlights.label: No Greed
highlights.detail: Confirm the hunter has left before reviving to avoid losing two players.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about Saw Genesis Wiki, its characters, traps, and release news.

items.question: What is Saw Genesis Wiki?
items.answer: Saw Genesis Wiki is a community resource for the franchise's origin era and the trap-based survival game built around it — the 2003 short, the 2004 film, the characters behind Jigsaw, and the mechanics that decide every room.

items.question: Is Saw Genesis a game or a movie?
items.answer: This Saw Genesis Wiki covers both: the origin chapter of the film franchise and the 3v1 trap-survival game, so you can follow the story and learn the mechanics in one place.

items.question: How do I survive a trap?
items.answer: Read the room before you move, disarm traps only while the hunter is accounted for, and treat communication as a mechanic rather than a courtesy.

items.question: Which characters matter most?
items.answer: Start with John Kramer, Amanda Young, and Lawrence Gordon — the Saw Genesis Wiki character pages explain how each one shapes the games.

items.question: Where can I find release and platform news?
items.answer: The release section of Saw Genesis Wiki tracks store pages, platform status, and how to verify any date before you believe it.
